any: You lost, or do you work here?
chatty: Hi! Haven't seen you around. I'm {name}.
New around here? I can tell you where everything is.
grumpy: Who's this now?
Another one. Great.
nervous: Um. Who are you?
Are you new? Nobody told me anything.
cheerful: Hey there! First time down here?
Oh, a new face. Hi!

chatty: {staff}! Got a minute? I've got news.
Hey {staff}, how's the outpost doing?
grumpy: {staff}.
Oh. It's you, {staff}.
nervous: Hi, {staff}. Everything okay?
Oh, it's you, {staff}. Good.
cheerful: Hey, {staff}! Good to see you.
{staff}! How's your day going?

any: Evening, {staff}. Thanks for the other day.
{staff}! You're one of the good ones.
chatty: {staff}! Sit down, I've got a story for you.
Hey {staff}, you're my favorite. Don't tell the others.
grumpy: {staff}. You're alright, I suppose.
Oh, {staff}. At least it's you.
nervous: Oh, {staff}. Good. I feel better when you're around.
Hi, {staff}. Glad it's you on shift.
cheerful: {staff}! Best part of my day.
Hey, look, it's {staff}! Hi!

chatty: Oh, {staff}. Try not to hit anyone today, yeah?
{staff}. Everyone's behaving, so relax.
grumpy: {staff}. Keep your hands to yourself.
Look who it is. {staff}.
nervous: Oh. H-hi, {staff}.
{staff}. I'm not doing anything, okay?
cheerful: Hey, {staff}. Nice and easy today, okay?
Morning, {staff}. Let's all keep it friendly.

any: Oh, it's you. Keep that baton away from me.
Great. {staff}. Who are you hitting today?
chatty: Hey, everyone, {staff}'s here. Nobody move too fast.
{staff}. We all know what you did.
grumpy: Get lost, {staff}.
{staff}. Come closer and see what happens.
nervous: Oh no. {staff}.
Please don't, {staff}. I didn't do anything.
cheerful: Oh. {staff}. Hi. Everyone's being good, see?
Easy, {staff}. Nobody wants trouble.

any: Can't see your face. Who is that?
Hey, you in the mask. Who are you?
chatty: Hey, who's that behind the mask? Come on, tell me.
Love the mask. Very mysterious.
grumpy: Take that thing off.
Hiding your face? Figures.
nervous: Why are you wearing that? Who are you?
I don't like it when I can't see faces.
cheerful: Ooh, a mystery guest!
Hi, whoever you are!

any: Heard {staff} runs a fair wing. That true?
Somebody told me to ask for {staff}.
Word is {staff} actually feeds people here.
chatty: The guys on the transport said {staff} is decent. Who's {staff}?
I heard about {staff} two outposts ago. Good things.
grumpy: Somebody said {staff} was fair. I'll believe it when I see it.
nervous: They said {staff} is nice. Is {staff} nice?
Is it true about {staff}? That they're fair?
cheerful: Heard this place has {staff}. Lucky me.
They told me {staff}'s one of the good ones.

any: Which one's {staff}? I want to know who to avoid.
Heard {staff} likes the baton a bit much.
Word on the transport was to stay clear of {staff}.
chatty: So, the guys on the transport told me about {staff}. Is it true?
Everybody's got a story about {staff}. None of them good.
grumpy: Heard about {staff}. Let them try it with me.
{staff}, right? I've heard.
nervous: Is {staff} here? They said {staff} hits people.
Please tell me {staff} isn't on shift.
cheerful: Heard {staff} can be rough. I'll keep smiling.
They told me to keep my head down around {staff}.

any: You don't get to calm me down, {staff}.
chatty: Oh, now you want to talk? After the baton? No.
You hit people, {staff}. Find someone else to chat with.
grumpy: Get your hands away from me, {staff}.
Not a chance.
nervous: Please just stay away from me.
No, no. Not you.
cheerful: Sorry. Not from you.
Maybe send someone else, yeah?

any: I'm starving. When did anyone last eat in here?
Honestly? I'm so hungry I can't think.
chatty: How am I doing? My stomach's been talking louder than me all day.
Starving. I'd eat the mattress if it was softer.
grumpy: How do you think? Nobody's fed me.
Starving. Thanks for asking. Now do something.
nervous: I feel sick, I'm so hungry. Is there food?
Did everyone forget about meals?
cheerful: Honestly, I'd kill for a sandwich right now.
Starving, but hey, still breathing.

any: Fine, but I could use a meal.
chatty: Hungry! Is there anything on the hatch? I'll take anything.
My stomach's growling. You hear that?
grumpy: Hungry. Hatch is empty again.
Could do with some food. Hint.
nervous: A bit hungry. Is that okay to say?
Is there food soon? Just asking.
cheerful: Pretty good! Could use a snack, though.
Hungry, but I'll live.

any: Look at me. This jumpsuit's disgusting.
I stink. I need a clean jumpsuit.
Filthy. Can I get a fresh uniform?
Flies are following me around. That's how I'm doing.
chatty: I've worn this thing so long it's got its own smell. Clean one?
Even the flies are complaining about me.
grumpy: I'm filthy, and you know it.
This suit's rotting on me. Do something.
nervous: I'm really dirty. Is that going to get me in trouble?
Could I please get a clean uniform?
cheerful: Great, apart from the smell. Fresh suit?
I'm okay! The jumpsuit isn't.

any: Fine, but I need a fresh uniform soon.
Getting a bit ripe in here.
chatty: Not bad, but this jumpsuit's had better days. Any clean ones?
I spilled something on this yesterday. Or last week.
grumpy: My suit's dirty. Same as always.
Could use a clean jumpsuit. Not that anyone listens.
nervous: My uniform's dirty. Sorry.
Can I get a clean jumpsuit? If it's not a bother.
cheerful: Good! Jumpsuit could use a wash, though.
Pretty good. Bit grubby, that's all.

any: I'm hurt. Could someone look at this?
chatty: I took a knock and it's still killing me. Got a bandage?
Bleeding a bit. Is that normal? It doesn't feel normal.
grumpy: I'm hurt. Obviously.
Still hurting. Nobody's done a thing about it.
nervous: It really hurts. Am I going to be okay?
Can someone look at this? Please?
cheerful: Seen better days! Got a bandage?
Bit sore. I'll be fine with a patch.

any: How do you think? I've been shut in here for ages.
Let me out of this cell for a bit.
I'm going stir crazy in here.
Locked in all day. That's how I'm doing.
chatty: I've counted every bolt on this door twice. Can I come out?
Talking to the wall's getting old. Let me out?
grumpy: Open the door and I'll tell you.
Locked up in a box. Great, thanks.
nervous: Why am I still locked in? Did I do something?
Please, can I come out for a bit?
cheerful: Getting a bit cramped in here! Can I stretch my legs?
I'm fine, but I'd be finer out there.

any: My cell's pitch black. Can you fix the light?
Can't see a thing in my cell.
The light in my cell's out.
It's dark as a cave in my cell.
chatty: My light's dead. I keep walking into the toilet.
Can someone fix my light? I can't even read.
grumpy: My light's been out forever. Fix it.
Dark in my cell. Again.
nervous: It's so dark in my cell. I don't like it.
My light's out. Can you fix it? Please?
cheerful: Fine! Could use a light in my cell, though.
My cell's a bit dark. Ghost stories, anyone?

any: Hard to see anything in this place.
chatty: Did the lights go out, or did I go blind?
It's like living in a cupboard in here.
grumpy: It's dark. Fix the lights.
Who turned the lights off? Turn them back on.
nervous: I don't like how dark it's getting.
Can we get the lights fixed? Please?
cheerful: Fine! Bit gloomy, though.
Could use a few more lights, but I'm okay.

chatty: Have you seen the floor? I stepped in something this morning.
I'd clean it myself if you gave me a mop.
grumpy: Floor's filthy. Get a mop.
This place stinks. Clean it.
nervous: It's so dirty in here. Is that safe?
Can someone clean up? There's stuff everywhere.
cheerful: Good! The floor's seen better days, though.
Fine. Could use a mop in here.

any: Nothing works in here. No power.
The power's been off for ages.
chatty: The power's off and it's really quiet. I don't like quiet.
Even the water cooler gave up. Power's out.
grumpy: No power. Great place you run.
Power's out. Fix it.
nervous: Why's the power off? Is something wrong?
Everything's off. Should I be worried?
cheerful: Power's out! Bit like camping.
Fine, except for the power.

any: There's somebody in here I can't stand.
chatty: Honestly? It's {other}. Always in my face.
Everything's fine apart from a certain someone.
grumpy: {other}. That's my problem.
One more word from {other} and I swear.
Somebody in here's getting on my nerves.
nervous: {other} scares me a bit.
Someone in here really doesn't like me.
cheerful: Good! Mostly. {other} and I don't get on.
Pretty good, apart from one grumpy neighbor.

chatty: Pretty good! Got a basketball game going later.
Honestly, better than my last ship. Don't tell anyone.
grumpy: Fine. Don't make it weird.
It's fine. Leave it at that.
nervous: Okay, I think. Why? Is something wrong?
I'm fine. I'm fine. Thanks.
cheerful: Great! Thanks for asking!
Good, really. People are nice here.

any: They got me for {crime}. Don't laugh.
chatty: Oh, {crime}. Want the long version? It's a good one.
They wrote down {crime}, but it was a misunderstanding.
grumpy: I'm in for {crime}. Happy now?
They got me for {crime}. I'd do it again.
nervous: It was {crime}. Only the once, I swear.
They say {crime}. I didn't mean it.
cheerful: Oh, {crime}! Not my finest moment.
I'm in for {crime}. You should've seen it.

any: Alright, alright. Back to my cell.
Sure. I'll sit down for a bit.
chatty: Alright, but I was in the middle of something. Going.
Okay, okay! I'll go sit on my bunk.
grumpy: Fine. But only because I want to.
Whatever. I'm going.
nervous: Okay! Sorry. Going now.
Did I do something wrong? Okay, I'm going.
cheerful: Sure thing! Nap time.
No problem. I'll be on my bunk.

chatty: Nah, I'm good out here. Nice try, though.
Why? I haven't done anything. I'm staying.
grumpy: Not a chance.
Go sit in a cell yourself.
nervous: Do I have to? I'd rather not.
Please, I only just got out here.
cheerful: Nah, I'm enjoying the fresh air. Well, the air.
I'll pass, thanks!

chatty: In, out, in, out. Pick one, would you?
That's three times now. I'm counting.
grumpy: Tell me one more time. See what happens.
Enough. I'm not going.
nervous: Why do you keep doing this?
Again? What did I do?
cheerful: Ha. No. Nice try, though.
You really want me in there, huh? No.

any: Sitting in my cell like I was told.
Happy now? I'm in my cell.
How long do I have to sit here?
Nice bunk. Same as it was ten minutes ago.
chatty: So this is what I get for being friendly.
Hey, can I come out yet? Just checking.
grumpy: Sent to my room like a kid.
This is stupid.
nervous: Am I in trouble? Nobody said.
I'll stay here. It's fine.
cheerful: Quiet time. I'll take it.
Could use a rest anyway.

chatty: Okay, I'm up. Looking for something? I'll stand over here.
Up I get. Nothing under there but lumps, you know.
grumpy: I was comfortable, you know.
Fine. Up.
nervous: Okay, okay, I'm up. I didn't do anything.
Up. Sorry. Is something wrong?
cheerful: No trouble. I needed to stretch anyway.
Up and about. Go ahead.

any: What time is it? Okay, okay, I'm up.
Do you mind? I was sleeping.
Can't a person get some sleep in here?
I was having a good dream, too.
Alright, I'm awake. What do you want?
chatty: Oh, hey. I was just resting my eyes. Totally awake.
Was that really necessary? I'm up, I'm up.
grumpy: You woke me up for this? Unbelievable.
Shake me like that again and see what happens.
nervous: What? What's wrong? Is something happening?
Okay! Okay, I'm awake! Don't hurt me.

any: I was lying down. Is that a crime now?
Can't anyone get some rest in here?
Every time I lie down, somebody wants something.
chatty: Oh sure, take my one comfy spot. Don't mind me.
You could have asked nicely. I'm up, I'm up.
grumpy: Unbelievable. Go on, tear my bunk apart.
I'm up. Don't expect me to like it.
nervous: I'm up, I'm up. Please don't make a mess of it.
Is this about something? I'm up, alright?
cheerful: Well, that was a short rest.
Fine. Try not to lose my pillow.
